Official Brian guide '(Boost Ratio 3:1)' notation (e.g. Frenzy); the separate-hit semantics follow the native RandomEnemy / RandomPrefNotPrevEnemy steps.

L7B05 troop:7344 describe: binding/prototype (4 segments)/zh; 4 real casts (4 hits, no consecutive repeat, armor 53 -> +18); 2 living alternate, 1 living x4, all enemies reachable over seeds; killed enemy not reselected; low-mana/silence.
